name: Tipsy Cafe & Restaurant
why_it_matters: Four-table cafe at the centre of Gandhi Chowk and the most consistently top-ranked eatery on TripAdvisor Lansdowne. Phulkas come hot off the tawa with the chicken lababdar — the dish locals send tourists for.
insider_tip: Seating is just four tables, no alcohol on the menu, and the kitchen winds down early — be in by 8pm or you'll be ordering takeaway.
signature_address: Lansdowne Market Road, Gandhi Chowk, Lansdowne 246155, Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand

name: Lansdowne Trip Travel Cafe
area: Kotdwar-Pauri Road, near St Mary's Church
why_it_matters: Run by Amit and Shipra — a cliff-edge cafe overlooking oak forest and snow ranges, doubling as a vintage shop with vinyl on an antique record player. Awarded TripAdvisor Travellers' Choice 2025 and Lansdowne's #1 cafe ranking for six straight years.
insider_tip: Closed Wednesdays. They make their own pizza base and sauce on site; the cliff-side seats fill first — go before sunset for the valley light.
signature_address: Kotdwar-Pauri Road, near St Mary's Church, Lansdowne 246155, Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand

name: Kaludanda Cafe
signature_dish: paneer butter masala with tandoori roti
why_it_matters: Lakeside cafe inside the Bhulla Tal complex maintained by the Indian Army — "Kaludanda" was Lansdowne's pre-British Garhwali name. The default refuel after the Bhulla Tal walk; outdoor seating directly on the lake edge.
insider_tip: Open 8am-9:30pm. The army-run kitchen has a working tandoor — order rotis fresh rather than the pre-made wraps, which sit longer than they should.
signature_address: Bhulla Tal, Lansdowne 246155, Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand

name: Cafe Ullasa
area: Mall Road, near Cantonment Board Office
why_it_matters: Mall Road cafe-and-camping setup near the Cantonment Board, with outdoor mountain-view seating. One of the few full-service cafe options on the Mall Road stretch outside the Gandhi Chowk cluster.
insider_tip: Service is slow when buses arrive — order at the counter rather than waiting for table service. They also run camping cottages on the same plot if you want to extend.
signature_address: Mall Road, near Cantonment Board Office, Lansdowne 246155, Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand

name: Mayur Hotel & Restaurant
why_it_matters: Pure-veg restaurant attached to Mayur Hotel right at the Gandhi Chowk circle, doubling as Lansdowne's reliable chaat-and-sweets stop. Chole bhature, samosas and dosa land fast; ice cream counter for the walk back uphill.
insider_tip: There are two listings around the same name in Gandhi Chowk — the one inside Mayur Hotel is the established kitchen; the standalone counter has shorter hours.
signature_address: Survey No. 199/206, Gandhi Chowk, Sadar Bazar, Lansdowne 246155, Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand

name: Zayka Restaurant
why_it_matters: Budget Gandhi Chowk hole-in-the-wall — one of the few places on the main circle that does both veg thalis and proper non-veg gravies at backpacker prices. Quick service, limited seating, no frills.
insider_tip: Six tables and a takeaway window. If Tipsy is full, this is the next-door fallback that locals actually use.
signature_address: Gandhi Chowk, Lansdowne 246155, Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand

name: Oaktown's Flavor
why_it_matters: Self-styled "multi-cuisine family restaurant" on Lansdowne Market Road — sit-down option a notch above the Gandhi Chowk dhabas, with proper plated thalis and a working tandoor. Takeaway counter for the trail crowd.
insider_tip: Phone +91 94124 06901 — call ahead in peak season; the dining room is small and tour groups can take it whole. Jaipuri handi is the kitchen's home dish.
signature_address: Lansdowne Market Road, Gandhi Chowk, Sadar Bazar, Lansdowne 246155, Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand

name: Pelican Restaurant (Blue Pine Resort)
why_it_matters: In-house multi-cuisine restaurant at Blue Pine Resort — the most consistent kitchen in Lansdowne for Garhwali staples (kafuli, mandua roti, phaanu) alongside the standard Indian-Chinese menu. Open to non-residents for lunch and dinner.
insider_tip: Ask for the Garhwali thali off-menu — it isn't always printed but the kitchen runs it for guests who request it. Buffet breakfast is the better-value slot.
signature_address: Blue Pine Resort, Lansdowne 246155, Pauri Garhwal, Uttarakhand
